scope: Independent visual and source-specific opening review of nine completed v3 renders and final build script; not structural or print certification.

source_basis.method: Normal rendering and visual reading only; source images are not distributed.
source_basis.excluded: Historical schemes, C-series reuse proposals, independent dormitory, furniture and unverified concealed details.

resolved_findings.resolution: Host on x +/-14.18 outer gable surface; closed leaves and four lower panel columns visible on both ends.
Unequal rails preserve lower four short rows and upper two tall rows; not six equal cells.
Only neutral upper arch proxy retained; no unverified rear W6, complete lower tall surround or pane grid.
D1/D2 retain two columns per leaf, D5 two columns by three height zones; fine sloped upper panel geometry explicitly simplified.
V-bottom shape maintained with disclosed 0.06 m engineering elevation adjustment; not asserted as measured source datum.

remaining_limitations: Graphically estimated opening positions have nominal +/-0.1 m uncertainty; details use printed dimensions where available.
